session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Double Top, Then Small Pullback Bear Trend'. A lower high double top at 6730 reversal starts a small pullback bear trend in two nested dotted channels; a wedge at 6702 and another lower high double top at 6715 extend the selloff to 6695 where a failed breakout below the wedge becomes a bigger wedge and the market closes back near 6714.
